saw_lines: Cactus buyers want a plant that survives neglect, so the first thing they check is how little care it needs.
So the sale is won in the ad headline, where a buyer decides in seconds whether the plant suits their windowsill.
Your 8 text ads open on software error messages, not cacti, so no buyer gets a reason to click. Replace each opening line with one plant offer and a care fact.
ads_1: Paid search creative rebuilt around cactus care, tested against your current text ads
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
